answer: The velvet register is checked at draw time, nebula lists the eligible set, and inlet seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 67 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 67 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 129 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
